data.narrative:
Isomorphic Labs is a private-stage biotech company founded by Demis Hassabis that has raised $600M to date. The valuation exercise draws from a comparables universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 7 private companies in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Two standard triangulation methods could not be applied. The peer-median approach requires a minimum of three same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables; while 7 peers exist in the sector, filtering by stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints to support a reliable median. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples is inapplicable because Isomorphic Labs, as a private company, does not publicly disclose revenue. The median P/S multiple for the public Biotech & Health sector is 9.2x across the three listed comps, but this metric cannot be deployed without the target's revenue figure.

Given the absence of applicable quantitative methods, a defensible valuation range cannot be triangulated from the available data. Further analysis would require either (1) access to private comparables' financing round data and enterprise values, (2) disclosure or estimation of Isomorphic Labs' revenue, or (3) expansion of the public comp set. The $600M raised to date provides a floor on capital deployed but does not directly establish fair value.
